newsitem.title: UK: Saudi tells OPEC May output 8.009 mln bpd.
newsitem.headline: Saudi tells OPEC May output 8.009 mln bpd.

text.p: Saudi Arabia told OPEC it produced 8.009 million barrels per day (bpd) in May, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said on Wednesday.
The data were submitted directly to OPEC headquarters in Vienna.
Saudi Arabia, the cartel's biggest producer and exporter, said its supply to the market last month was 8.00 million bpd, exactly in line with its OPEC quota.
Kuwait told OPEC it produced 2.003 million bpd in May, OPECNA said.
A Reuters survey of analysts and industry sources on Thursday found that Saudi Arabia produced 8.08 million bpd and Kuwait 2.07 million bpd in May.
